audience: print-on-demand sellers who make and ship custom products with CustomCat

useCases.title: List our products, variants and designs
useCases.text: Lists the products you set up with variants, SKUs, cost and price, opens one product, and lists the uploaded designs.

useCases.title: Browse the catalog of blank products
useCases.text: Lists catalog categories and the blank products you can print on, and shows a product's colors, sizes and SKUs.

useCases.title: Check stock for a SKU and the shipping cost
useCases.text: Checks a catalog SKU for price and stock status, lists the shipping methods for a country, and quotes the shipping cost for SKUs and quantities.

useCases.title: Check an order's status and tracking
useCases.text: Reads an order by your order id: its status, production status of each item, shipments with tracking ids and totals.

useCases.title: Place an order for printing and shipping
useCases.text: Places an order for CustomCat to print and ship. It charges the payment method on file, so check the SKUs and shipping method first.

useCases.title: Cancel an order
useCases.text: Cancels an order by your order id. Only an order that has not gone into production can be cancelled.
